intro.title: Welcome to SupoClip
intro.body: Give us a long video and we turn its best moments into short vertical clips, captioned and ready to post. Take a two-minute tour: how to make your first clips, then every page you’ll use.

source.title: Start with a video
source.body: Paste a YouTube, Twitch, or Kick link here, or upload a file with the paperclip, then press the arrow. Podcasts, interviews, and talks of 10 minutes or more work best.

workflows.title: Choose what to make
workflows.body: Highlights gives you the best standalone moments, and it’s the right pick for a first try. The others turn one video into a series, a recap, a trailer, or every clip about a topic.

settings.title: Set the look once
settings.body: Clip length, caption style, framing, and B-roll live in this menu. The defaults are good, and whatever you change is remembered for next time.

library.title: Library
library.body: Every video you clip lands here, newest first, and you can search them. You can leave while one is processing; it keeps going and shows up here when it’s done.

libraryClips.title: Your clips, ranked
libraryClips.body: Open a video to see its clips, best score first. Download one or all of them, or open a clip in the studio to trim it, fix a caption, or reframe it.

social.title: Connect your accounts
social.body: Link your social accounts here to post clips straight from SupoClip, without downloading them first.

analytics.title: See what works
analytics.body: Views, likes, and comments from your posts come back here, by platform, hook, and length. After a few posts, SupoClip uses them to pick clips more like your best ones.

agents.title: Clip from your AI assistant
agents.body: Connect Claude, ChatGPT, or Grok and ask for clips in a chat: paste the server URL and sign in, no key to copy. Building something? Create an API key below.

captions.title: Your caption style
captions.body: Set the font, size, and color every new video starts with, and see a preview. You can still change them for a single video.

plan.title: Your plan
plan.body: Plans count minutes of the videos you bring, not clips. See what you’ve used this month, and change your plan here.

finish.title: You’re ready
finish.body: That’s everything. Paste your first link here and we’ll take it from there.

intro.title: Introducing workflows
intro.body: Workflows let you choose what to make before you start. Besides highlights, one video can now become a numbered series, every clip about a topic, a recap, or a trailer. Here’s a one-minute look at each.

highlights.title: Highlights
highlights.body: What you already know: the best moments, each one working on its own. This is still the default.

series.title: Series
series.body: Turns a long video into numbered parts that play in order, each leaving people wanting the next. Great for stories and tutorials.

topic.title: Topic
topic.body: Name a subject and get every strong moment about it, like “pricing” in a long interview. You type it in the line that appears under your link.

recap.title: Recap
recap.body: One short video covering the main points of the whole thing, with the points listed on screen.

trailer.title: Trailer
trailer.body: One short preview made to get people to watch the full video, without giving away the ending.

instructions.title: Add your own direction
instructions.body: Whichever you pick, add a note like “only the funny moments” and the clips follow it.

settings.title: Everything else lives here
settings.body: Length, captions, framing, cleanup, and B-roll are now in one menu. We remember your choices, so you only set them once.

settings.title: Everything else lives here
settings.body: Length, captions, framing, cleanup, and B-roll are now in one menu. We remember your choices, so you only set them once.

intro.title: Introducing Dynamic edits
intro.body: Your clips can now be edited the way top short-form editors do it: animated captions, reframes, sound effects and music, placed on the moments that matter. The AI finds those moments; you choose how hard they hit.

intensity.title: Pick how hard it hits
intensity.body: Subtle: outlined subtitles, a reframe now and then and a quiet music bed, like a podcast clip. Bold: Hormozi-style captions on a dark pill, word by word with the key word boxed, and punch-ins that hold. Max: heavy outlined caps, a reframe on almost every line, louder hits and the odd flash at a cut. Off keeps clips as they are.

sound.title: Sound, music and swearing
sound.body: Sound effects land on cuts and on-screen moments, never on plain talking. Music comes in seven moods, from chill to aggressive: leave it on “Match the video” and the AI picks one that fits, or choose it yourself. Swear words are bleeped and shown as f*** in the captions. Once edits are on, each has a switch under Fine-tune.

captions.title: Animated caption styles
captions.body: Highlighter boxes the key word, Emoji Drop puts an emoji under the thing being talked about, and Behind Head sets one giant word behind the speaker. Each takes the look of your intensity, and works on its own with edits off.

intro.title: Dynamic edits in the studio
intro.body: Every effect on a clip can be changed here before you export, one at a time or all at once.

panel.title: The Edits tab
panel.body: Change this clip's intensity, music mood or switches, ask the AI to plan the edits again, or remove them all. The list shows each moment the AI picked: click one to jump to it. Every change can be undone.

lane.title: Each effect on the timeline
lane.body: Every zoom and sound is a block here, and the music lane shows the bed under the voice. Drag a block to move it, double-click to change it, or select it and press Delete. Double-click an empty spot to add a sound.
